description: Taiwan tax dispute dates: 復查 within 30 days from the day after the payment period ends (or after the assessment notice is served) (Tax Collection Act art. 35), 訴願 within 30 days of service of the review decision (Administrative Appeal Act art. 14), administrative lawsuit within 2 months of the appeal decision (Administrative Litigation Act art. 106), overpaid tax refund within 10 years of payment or 15 years when the government is at fault (Tax Collection Act art. 28). Weekend shifts only. Taiwan, as of 2026-11-21 (law.moj.gov.tw and Ministry of Finance). General information and estimates only; no individual tax advice, agency or filing. The 2025 tax year is 114年度, filed in May 2026; national-holiday deadline shifts are not computed, only weekends.

noticeDelivered.description: Date the assessment notice was served (if no tax bill)

paid.description: Date the overpaid tax was paid

paymentPeriodEnd.description: Last day of the payment period on the tax bill

petitionDecision.description: Date the appeal decision was served

reviewDecision.description: Date the review decision was served
